en.plugins.youtube.desc: Download YouTube videos and audio, or search YouTube
en.plugins.youtube.usage_download:
❌ Provide a YouTube link.

Example: {0}ytdl https://youtube.com/watch?v=...

• {0}ytdl / {0}ytv: video (15 min max)
• {0}yta: audio (60 min max)
• {0}yts <query>: search
en.plugins.youtube.usage_search:
❌ Provide something to search for.

Example: {0}yts despacito
en.plugins.youtube.invalid_link: ❌ Invalid or unavailable link. Send the link of a public YouTube video (youtube.com or youtu.be).
